primary_candidates.name: Qwen3.5-4B

onnx.note: Repository contains multiple precision variants; full repository size is not the browser download size. Measure the selected files and peak memory.

open_risks: An open Transformers.js issue reports slow Qwen3.5-4B WebGPU prefill/decode on one setup; reproduce locally.
MLX-to-PEFT native parity passed on a 9B format fixture, but current public Qwen3.5 Optimum/Transformers.js exporter code is unavailable; trained-weight ONNX reproducibility remains blocked.

primary_candidates.name: Gemma-3n-E4B-it

upstream.parameter_note: Approximately 8B total parameters with E4B effective activation/memory behavior; not a literal 4B checkpoint.

primary_candidates.license_gate: pending terms review and account acceptance
open_risks: Current MLX-VLM LoRA documentation excludes Gemma3n, so training may require PyTorch/PEFT.
Actual parameter/storage footprint is closer to 8B even though active memory is advertised as E4B.
No JEE pilot score or browser measurement yet.

primary_candidates.name: LFM2.5-VL-3B
open_risks: Liquid AI recommends the model for fast single-turn work and says it is not recommended for reasoning-intensive technical questions.
Trainability and adapter export through the exact local stack need a one-update preflight.

challengers.name: Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking
challengers.purpose: Reasoning-oriented native/server challenger in the smoke screen.
challengers.limit: No confirmed matching Transformers.js ONNX Thinking build in this review; do not advance to product finalist without one.

challengers.name: Phi-4-multimodal-instruct
challengers.purpose: Optional server-side challenger if the primary candidates fail the reasoning gate.
challengers.limit: Larger/custom-code model and no confirmed direct Transformers.js route; not a first browser finalist.
